title: Beevibe Architecture Deep Research Hard Constraints
description: Structured constraint list extracted from the PRD + clarification answers. must_have constraints filter the candidate pool before the comparison matrix is built — candidates that fail any must_have are eliminated, not just penalized. preferred + nice_to_have inform scoring without filtering.

statement.description: The constraint in plain language as the user expressed it.

severity.description: must_have eliminates candidates; preferred / nice_to_have are scoring inputs.

check_question.description: The yes/no question to ask of each candidate to verify compliance.

evidence_from_input.description: Quoted text from the PRD or clarification answers that established this constraint.
